deadline.value: Priority review needs all materials by December 1, 2026; the final application deadline is December 31, 2026.
deadline.quote: For priority review of your application, all materials need to be submitted by December 1, 2026.

gre_general.value: GRE General is optional and not submitting it does not hurt your application.
gre_general.quote: GRE General Test scores (GRE is optional; choosing not to submit GRE scores will not impact your admissions decision)

gre_subject.value: The pages checked do not mention the Chemistry Subject GRE.

supervisor.value: No need to contact faculty before applying; students choose a research group (preceptor) during the fall of the first year.
supervisor.quote: There is no need to contact chemistry faculty members during the application process.

also.quote: Our preceptor selection process takes place during the fall semester of the first year.

funding.value: All accepted PhD students get full support (tuition, health insurance subsidy and monthly stipend) for all five years.
funding.quote: provides full support (tuition, health insurance subsidy, and a monthly stipend) in the form of a teaching assistantship/research assistantship/fellowship to all accepted graduate students for all five years of study

entry_route.value: Applicants with only a bachelor's degree are encouraged to apply to the PhD; a master's is not required.
entry_route.quote: Yes, undergraduate applicants are encouraged to apply. A master’s degree is not required.

fee_waiver.value: The department pays the application fee for a limited number of applicants in financial hardship.
fee_waiver.quote: the Department of Chemistry has funding available to pay the application fee for a limited number of applicants

notes: Department quotes the $65 fee without the international rate, so no department fee is set. Department TOEFL minimum is printed on the old 120-point scale.
